findings.identity: Correct Yue Han Pavilion, not Mei/Ji pavilions or Yue Han Hall.
findings.roof: Broad circular very shallow roof/eave matches observed pavilion identity, without erroneous traditional pointed roof. Top surface not independently verified.
findings.ring: Twelve portals explicitly supported by official text; generator twelve piers and bays produce coherent open ring. Regular dimensions are approximated.
findings.piers_and_panels: Broad vertical piers and deep high panels retain source morphology and approximate relative proportions.
findings.clerestory: Narrow upper band retained, visibly blue-gray opaque proxy rather than actual source transparent glazing; prominently documented.
findings.stairs_and_base: Front access retained. Exposed round solid base visually differs from wooded hill; accepted ONLY as clearly disclosed artificial terrain display support.
findings.omissions: No invented lettering or emblem; declared omissions consistent.
findings.five_preview_review: Personally inspected front, elevation, left_oblique, rear and top image pixels. Reopened official exterior and reverse-interior after reviewing model for direct comparison; all six source photos and full book page were personally inspected in research phase.
